reviews.text:
Expected a proper lunch experience at this A2B, but the visit turned out to be disappointing. Arriving around 12:15 PM on Saturday, I was surprised to find that lunch items such as mini lunch, bisi bele bath and other south indian rice varieties were not available, even though the menu clearly stated that lunch service begins at 12:00 PM. Instead, only some breakfast items and north indian items were being served. For a well-known chain like A2B, customers naturally expect menu items to be available as advertised. Unfortunately, that was not the case during this visit.

The only positives were the ample parking space and the clean, well-maintained restroom facilities. Other than that, there was little to appreciate. If you're looking for a reliable lunch option, I would suggest considering other restaurants in the area.

reviews.author: Rinaldi James
reviews.text:
This location has improved quite a bit since my last visit many years ago. It is a little more pricey than restaurants within Bangalore but not unaffordable. If you do drive to Bangalore from the airport or from anywhere beyond the Airport's Toll Gate. Do consider stopping here.

Dishes:
1. Vada - 4.5 star. Good portion size and tastes as good as they look.
2. Dosa - 4 star. Not as good as the ones you'd get at Taaza Thindi or Arogya Ahaara, just to name a few. The potato filling inside is also a little bland.
3. Coffee - 5 star. You can sort of customize how much sugar and coffee you want by requesting them to do so at the coffee counter.
4. Packaged food and sweets: 5 star. .They've got a very wide range of sweets and packaged food, which is already a plus. The video of their factory and hygiene standards on YouTube assures you're not buying something poorly made. Almost on par with Haldirams (haldirams being slightly better).
5. Dinner choices in the first floor were not that great and cost higher than average prices. They were just OK enough.
6. The room (think it was called deluxe and was room no. 1) was not that good. While the price seemed alright and the room was quite spacious, there were food stains on the bedsheets, the floor had dirt, the bathroom and room in general was very outdated. It did include a mini tiffin breakfast which was kind of worth it.
7. Similar situation with the restaurant as well. There's some smell you get from frequently used cleaning cloths. The washroom needs big improvement.
8. Parking is still a minor concern during rush hour though there's enough now that the adjacent land (previously Lamborghini service centre) has opened up and there's some more parking under the metro bridge.
9. Reachability and location is quite good for those arriving or departing from/to the airport.

Overall. A relatively decent place for south Indian food in the area as an alternative to "Hotel Shivaprasad Veg" near the Toll Gate for South and North Indian veg food with the bonus of packed sweets and snacks.

reviews.author: Sona Suzanne
reviews.text:
Went to the A2B on the airport road on a Sunday morning.  My earlier experience was not too great, but this time I left as a happy customer. The food is tasty for sure, fast service and the overall dining experience was good. They have a self order kiosk to fasten The billing process. I liked it. The billing counter had a long queue and I escaped it by using the kiosk. Even after we took the coupon we had to wait a bit as they had many orders.
Then once we got our Dosa and Vada, we sat down to eat. Now they have started to give unlimited chutney too, which was not there before. The restroom is clean. The additional parking space is a blessing as we don't have to park on the road.

reviews.author: Hari Prasad Perabattula
reviews.text:
This is on the way to Bangalore from Airport on the service road.

How to reach there? Don't take the earlier exit before the A2B restaurant. Google maps shows this. There's another one after crossing A2B. Take it and travel back in the service road.

The food is tasty as with any A2B. They even have a separate place for serving. We have always sat in the self service section. The washroom/handwash area is very narrow. I had never seen it to be maintained well.

They have moderate amount of parking space. Can even park in the service road if needed.

reviews.author: Gopal Bhaskar
reviews.text: This is the veg hotel nearest to the airport that serves both south indian and north indian food. There are both self service and waiter service, at your choice. The wash facility and the toilet are neat. There is a car park for about 15 cars. You can also parkbon the roadside which does not have heavy traffic. The only inconvenience is that the coffee/tea counter is outside the main service area.
